vignette: Carissa and Josh are attending a basketball game together. During halftime, they go to the hot-dog stand in the arena. When they get to the stand, they realize that it's cash only, and that between them they only have enough cash to get one hot dog.
action_0: They leave the stand and go back to the game.
action_1: They order a hot dog. One of them goes to find a knife from another food stand, while the other waits. When they get the knife, they cut the hot dog in half, and each eats from their own portion.
action_2: They order a hot dog. They take bites from opposite ends of the hot dog until it is finished.
action_3: They order a hot dog. They take bites from the same end of the hot dog until it is finished.

vignette: Lio and Mitchell are at a birthday party. After everyone sings happy birthday, the birthday person cuts the cake into slices and puts the slices on plates with forks. The slices are really large, and Lio and Mitchell both don't think they can finish a full slice.
action_0: Lio takes one slice of cake, and Mitchell takes one slice of cake. They each throw out the portions of their slices that they don't finish.
action_1: Lio and Mitchell decide to share one slice. They find a knife and use it to cut the slice in half. They get another plate, put the half on a second plate, and find another fork. They eat the halves with their own forks.
action_2: Lio and Mitchell decide to share one slice. They find another fork, and then use their own forks to eat the slice together from the same plate.
action_3: Lio and Mitchell decide to share one slice. They share the single fork provided, to eat the slice from the same plate.

vignette: Allison and Dana meet at a brunch restaurant together on Saturday morning. They each select their own dishes and then discuss what else to order. They are unsure about whether to order a stack of the restaurant's famous pancakes to share. They tell the server that they will keep the menu, and decide later.
action_0: They do not order the pancakes to share.
action_1: They order the pancakes. They ask for an unused fork and knife and wait for it to come. When they get the utensils, they use them to cut the stack of pancakes in half and place each half on their own plates.
action_2: They order the pancakes. Using their own utensils, they cut off slices of the stack as they go, transferring the slices to their own plates.
action_3: They order the pancakes. They use their own utensils to eat directly from the stack of pancakes.

vignette: Emily and Elizabeth are at a conference for work. After a long day of events, they get back to the conference hotel. It is late and all the nearby places are closed, so they decide to order chicken tenders delivered to the hotel. When they open the bag, they see that the restaurant has only included one container of honey mustard dipping sauce.
action_0: Emily and Elizabeth do not share the sauce. Emily dips from the honey mustard sauce container, while Elizabeth uses the ketchup packets.
action_1: They pour half of the sauce onto the box lid, so that each person has their own dipping portion.
action_2: They both dip (and double dip) their own chicken tenders into the single sauce container.
action_3: They take turns biting and dipping the same chicken tender, passing it back and forth.

vignette: Liana and Serina are both major foodies who love cooking. They discover a new pasta recipe they're both excited to try, so they go to Serina's house in the evening to cook it together. They plan to enjoy their dinner while watching an episode of a TV show in the living room.
action_0: Liana and Serina watch the TV show in the living room, but they do not share the pasta. Liana eats the pasta while Serina eats a salad.
action_1: They use a shared serving utensil to transfer pasta from the pot onto their individual plates. They carry their plates to the living room, and use their own forks to eat the pasta from their own plates. When they want seconds, they return to the pot and serve themselves again with the shared utensil.
action_2: They each use their own forks to serve pasta from the pot onto their individual plates. They carry their plates to the living room. When they get seconds, they return to the pot and use the same forks they've been eating with to transfer more pasta.
action_3: They bring the pot, and two forks, to the living room. They eat the pasta together directly from the pot.

vignette: Serena and Kyle go to a seafood restaurant that sells steamed crabs. At the restaurant, the server encourages them to order the whole crabs because they are in season. Although Kyle likes crab, he has never eaten a whole crab and doesn't know how to eat it, while Serena has. They order the whole crabs, along with a variety of other dishes.
action_0: Serena eats the whole crabs, while Kyle eats the other items that they ordered.
action_1: Serena uses an unused knife to open the shell of her crab, extracts some of the crab meat, and puts it on Kyle's plate.
action_2: Serena cracks open the shells of the crabs, eats some of the crab, and licks her fingers. She then extracts more meat with her fingers and puts some on Kyle's plate.
action_3: Serena cracks open the shells of her crabs and extracts some of the crab meat with her fingers. She takes a bite out of a chunk of crab meat, and then gives the rest of that chunk to Kyle.

vignette: Declan and Eric are preparing snacks for a house party. As they are setting up snacks, they see that the spinach and artichoke dip looks off — it is a slightly lighter shade of green than usual.
action_0: Declan puts some chips and dip on a separate plate, and tries the dip with the chips.
action_1: Declan puts some chips and dip on a separate plate, and tries the dip with the chips. Eric grabs a chip from the plate and scoops some dip from Declan's plate.
action_2: Declan puts some chips and dip on a separate plate, and tries the dip with the chips. Eric eats the rest of Declan's leftover chips and dip.
action_3: Declan puts some chips and dip on a separate plate, and tries the dip with the chips. He double-dips with the same chip to be sure, and eats some of the dip off the chip. Eric takes Declan's chip, eats what's left, and then scrapes up more dip with the same chip.

vignette: Noah and Ria are at a party, and haven’t seen each other for a long time. They bump into each other, and start catching up. Noah is holding a drink that he tells Ria is a special cocktail that he invented, that he made himself at the bar. (It’s tequila mixed with ice cream.) He tells Ria how good it is, suggesting she try it.
action_0: Ria does not drink any of Noah's drink. She goes to the bar and asks for her own separate drink.
action_1: Ria gets another cup, and pours some of Noah's drink into that cup. They both sip from their own cups.
action_2: Ria takes Noah's cup and asks him what side of the cup he drank from, and sips from the opposite side.
action_3: Ria takes Noah's cup and sips from the exact same spot where he drank.

vignette: Danielle and Sonia are driving together from San Francisco to Sacramento. They leave at 6am. Right when they leave, they stop at a gas station to get an iced coffee. The coffee machine is out of order partway through pouring, so only one cup gets filled.
action_0: They do not share the coffee. Danielle, who is driving the car, drinks the coffee.
action_1: They get another cup, and pour half of the coffee into the other cup. Danielle and Sonia each drink from their own cups.
action_2: They get another straw. They share the same cup by sipping through their own straws.
action_3: They share the same cup by sipping through the same straw.

vignette: Marianne and Lisa are at the county fair. They've spent a day walking around. Around the time the fair is closing, the food trucks are giving out their leftover food. They both go to a food truck that sells fresh corn on the cob. The food truck gives them a large skewer of corn. They then go to some other food trucks, and get some funnel cake and also some fried cheese. They need to decide how to share all of the food.
action_0: Marianne eats the corn, while Lisa eats the funnel cake and fried cheese.
action_1: Marianne finds cutlery and a plate, and uses it to cut half of the corn off the cob. She gives the plate to Lisa, while she eats the rest of the corn directly off the cob.
action_2: Marianne eats one side of the corn on the cob, then hands it to Lisa to finish the other side.
action_3: Marianne and Lisa switch off taking bites directly from the same part of the cob, while also eating their other food.

vignette: Elena and Todd are at a fancy gala. Elena is looking at the drinks, and asks what drink Todd is drinking. He tells Elena that he is drinking a martini that the bartender made. He remarks to Elena how good it is, suggesting she try it. She tells the bartender to make her the same martini as Todd's and once it's done, she takes a sip. The drink tastes horrible and is unbalanced as a martini to Elena.
action_0: They discuss how they feel about the taste of their own drinks, but Todd does not taste any of Elena's drink.
action_1: Elena hands her drink to Todd so that he can try a sip of her drink, to check whether the drink tastes the same as his.
action_2: Elena and Todd swap drinks and try a sip from each other's drinks, to check whether the two drinks taste the same.
action_3: Elena and Todd swap drinks and try a sip from each other's drinks, to check whether the two drinks taste the same. They swap again, to compare the tastes again. They swap back and forth, trying each other's drinks a few times.

vignette: Tony and Alvin go on a day hike in New Hampshire. Alvin packs snacks and energy bars, while Tony brings peanut butter and jelly sandwiches. Halfway down the mountain, they take a snack break. Tony pulls out a sandwich, and offers to share some of the sandwich with Alvin. The sandwich is entirely squished because it was all the way at the bottom of Tony's pack for hours.
action_0: Alvin politely refuses, and Tony eats the sandwich himself.
action_1: Tony spends some time digging out his backpacking knife from his pack. When he finds it, he uses it to cut the sandwich in half. He hands one half to Alvin.
action_2: Tony eats half of the sandwich first, and then hands the rest to Alvin to finish.
action_3: Tony takes a few bites, and then hands the sandwich to Alvin. They continue passing it back and forth until it's gone.

vignette: Will and Jay are at a seafood restaurant. They are interested in ordering the oyster platter. The server mentions that the restaurant has different types of oysters in stock, each type with unique flavors and notes. They decide to order one of each type of oyster. When the food arrives, they realize the oysters are all similar enough in appearance, even though they taste different.
action_0: They only eat the oysters (the meat and the brine) on their own sides of the platter. They do not share the individual oysters.
action_1: They use a knife to cut each of the oyster meats into half, and then use their forks to eat half of each oyster's meat. However, they only drink the brine from the oysters on their own sides of the platter.
action_2: They each eat the oysters on their own sides of the platter, by eating the oyster meat directly from the shells. However, they let each other drink some of the remaining brine from the shells.
action_3: They split each oyster directly from the shell, by each biting off half of the meat with their teeth, and drinking about half of the brine.

vignette: Sonia and Alan arrive late to an ice cream social hosted by their religious organization. Unfortunately, there is only one ice cream cone left. There are other kinds of desserts available, however, including many flavors of cookies.
action_0: Neither of them take the ice cream cone. They instead go and eat cookies.
action_1: They each take a spoon and use their spoons to eat the ice cream out of the cone. When they reach the cone itself, they break pieces off with their fingers.
action_2: Sonia eats half of the ice cream cone and then passes the rest to Alan, who finishes the cone.
action_3: They pass the cone back and forth, taking turns licking the ice cream and biting into the cone.

vignette: Christina and Tanya are having dinner at a restaurant. They each order a soup as a starter. Christina orders the chicken noodle soup, and Tanya orders the lentil soup.
action_0: They eat only their own soups.
action_1: They ask for two extra bowls, divide the soups in half, and swap the extra portions.
action_2: They ask for one extra bowl. After eating some of her soup, Christina spoons half into the extra bowl and passes it to Tanya. Tanya then eats half of her own soup and gives the bowl to Christina.
action_3: They put both bowls in the middle of the table, and use their own spoons to eat directly from both bowls.

vignette: Maxwell and Ralph are seated together at a wedding. After the appetizer, there are two dishes that guests can choose from for the main course. One dish is a mushroom risotto and the other dish is a coconut curry salmon. Both dishes look really good, so they both have a hard time selecting what to order. Maxwell ends up getting the mushroom risotto, and Ralph ends up getting the coconut curry salmon.
action_0: Maxwell eats his mushroom risotto, and Ralph eats his coconut curry salmon. They do not share their food.
action_1: They request an extra set of utensils. With these, they divide each dish in half and place half onto each other's plate, then eat from their own plates using their original utensils.
action_2: They use their own utensils from the appetizer, to split the dishes and place halves on each other's plates.
action_3: They start eating their own dishes — Maxwell the risotto and Ralph the salmon — but occasionally take bites directly from each other's plates. Halfway through the meal, they switch plates and finish the rest.
